description:
STEP 2 (re-key on the arrow). Code-review note: activation inputs come from INFERENCE (arbitrary unification ids), not the resolver -- so the 13 scattered per-position passes collapse to ONE whole-scope canonicalization at the single key-mint site (the step that assigns addresses to those inference vars). They do not all vanish; they fold into one correct pass.

Work:
- ActivationKey carries arrow: Ty (the evidence surface; the RESULT is now explicit, no longer implied). Mark the old ActivationKey.input as Trash in the intro; replace its producer with the canonical-arrow mint.
- At the single mint, run ONE whole-scope canonicalization assigning addresses (a{i}/r0/P_j) to inference vars, then intern. Two alpha-equivalent activations are now interned-identical (pointer equality, zero comparison) -- intra-scope identity is free; cross-scope stays consistent-Sigma subsumption (key_subsumes_with / key_list_subsumes).
- Each per-position normalizer (semantic.rs 7x alpha_normalize, alpha_normalized_surfaces, normalize_contributions, the alpha loop in canonical_activation_key) is DELETED as its producer emits canonical arrows. Leave convergence keying to the next ticket.

Depends on: resolve emitter (fz-hwn.27.3), calculator extension (fz-hwn.27.4).
Checks: an activation key built from inference [Ty27,Ty28] interns DISTINCT from [Ty27,Ty27] (conflation gone); alpha-equivalent activations are one object; (a,b)->b key keeps b in result. Lib + matrix green, zero warnings.

comments.text: Carries its own Trash marks (deferred from 27.1): (a) the SharedTypes-trait-coupled alpha_normalize family + alpha_normalized_surfaces + normalize_contributions, and (b) ActivationKey.input / CallableSurface.inputs field-level items -- all marked here as they are superseded by the arrow re-key.

EMPIRICAL FINDING (probe at HEAD, reverted): applying whole-scope address_inputs at canonical_activation_key alone (the documented conflation site) cascades to ~30+ failing tests across closures, enum_reduce, native codegen, and fixture-fact SNAPSHOTS -- confirming the proposal's 'self-consistent wrongness / one-site fix de-synchronizes.' Decisive structural result: compiler2_abi_ready_matches_direct_callable_captures_by_canonical_activation_key and the enum_reduce/native failures are tied to CAPTURE IDENTITY. Since activation key inputs ARE capture_tys ++ surface.inputs (runtime_demand.rs:1428), re-keying inputs without the capture-slot model breaks capture matching. Therefore 27.6 (re-key) + 27.7 (convergence_collapse) + 27.8 (captures-as-addressed-slots) are ONE ATOMIC COMMIT (CLAUDE.md: 'if two steps cannot be performed atomically they are one step'), and that commit must also: switch every comparable normalization site together (CallableSurface::alpha_normalize + the 6 delegating sites + normalize_contributions), and update ~30 tests/snapshots. The address_inputs primitive (whole-scope canonicalization) is trivial (5 lines, in the 27.6 probe) and ready to re-add when the atomic swing is executed. Machinery (27.1-27.4) is complete and green; this is the integration swing.

RESCOPED as STEP 2b (the swing), now blocked by the half-step fz-hwn.27.11 which threads arrow: Ty with a none() sentinel result and projects the input side everywhere. This ticket becomes a PURELY SEMANTIC diff: replace the construction with whole-scope address_arrow(collapsed_inputs, fresh) -> (a0,a1,..) -> r0 (real r0 replaces the none() sentinel); switch the capture-prefix (runtime_demand.rs:1431), offset (1590), evidence (normalize_contributions world.rs:768), and callsite (define_callsite_summary world.rs:893) sites to ADDRESSED comparison -- relying on the left-to-right property address(full)[..k]==address(captures). Route matching through match_arrow; delete per-position normalizers; ~30 tests/snapshots move; fz-hwn.23 phantom (a0,a0) falls out. Folds 27.7 (convergence_collapse) + 27.8 (captures-as-addressed-slots) into this swing per the established atomicity finding.

A LANDED (uncommitted, lib 2240/0 GREEN, zero warnings). Chose path A (contained whole-scope addressing in compiler2 + DELETE the conflation engine; B = resolver construction root deferred, documented in proposal.html new section 'Two seams to canonical-by-construction'). What landed: (1) CallableSurface canonical-by-construction — CallableSurface::new(inputs, types) addresses whole-scope at birth; (2) key mint canonical — from_inputs uses Types::address_inputs (whole-scope, one shared sigma) + none() placeholder result (NOT r0: a key has no result to preserve identity against; r0 is a B/contract concern and empirically broke the boxing seam); (3) DELETED the entire alpha_normalize tree (CallableDemand/ShapeDemand/RuntimeDemand/CallableFlowFact/ExecutableRuntimeDemand::alpha_normalize + alpha_normalized_surfaces + all call sites incl world.rs define_semantic_closure/RuntimeDemandFacts::define) — it existed ONLY to normalize surfaces, now canonical by construction; (4) normalize_contributions + define_callsite_summary surface_inputs -> address_inputs (whole-scope, was per-input conflation); (5) capture/surface matching at runtime_demand (capture-prefix 1432, offset 491) + transport (boundary_return_shapes 2876) rewritten to the addressed frame via the left-to-right property address(cap++surf)[..k]==address(cap) and own-suffix re-addressed standalone == canonical surface; (6) fz-hwn.23 reducer ghost FIXED: phantom_resolution_keys drops value-template resolutions with a ground sibling (mirrors ground_dispatch_surfaces, keyed on new Types::is_value_template/key_is_value_template). ground_dispatch_surfaces KEPT (it's the surface grounding, not conflation). REMAINING: fz-hwn.27.12 (opaque_fn_value_join boxing-seam, matrix only). NOT committed (matrix not green). Tree builds clean; only proposal.html untracked + uncommitted src edits.

title: Re-key ActivationKey on the arrow: arrow: Ty (result explicit), whole-scope canonicalization at the single mint
